chunks.arabic_text: وَفِي رِوَايَةِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ

translations.en: And in the narration of al-Husayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُبْضِعُهُ الرَّجُلُ ثَلَاثِينَ دِرْهَمًا فِي ثَوْبٍ وَآخَرُ عِشْرِينَ دِرْهَمًا فِي ثَوْبٍ فَبَعَثَ الثَّوْبَيْنِ وَلَمْ يَعْرِفْ هَذَا ثَوْبَهُ وَلَا هَذَا ثَوْبَهُ

translations.en: Concerning a man whom another man entrusts with thirty dirhams for a garment, and another with twenty dirhams for a garment; then he sent the two garments, and this one did not know his garment, nor did that one know his garment.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ يُبَاعُ الثَّوْبَانِ فَيُعْطَى صَاحِبُ الثَّلَاثِينَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَخْمَاسِ الثَّمَنِ وَالْآخَرُ خُمُسَيِ الثَّمَنِ

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "The two garments are to be sold, then the صاحب of the thirty is given three-fifths of the price, and the other two-fifths of the price."

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ فَقُلْتُ فَإِنَّ صَاحِبَ الْعِشْرِينَ قَالَ لِصَاحِبِ الثَّلَاثِينَ اخْتَرْ أَيَّهُمَا شِئْتَ قَالَ لَقَدْ أَنْصَفَهُ

translations.en: He said: So I said, "If the صاحب of the twenty said to the صاحب of the thirty, 'Choose whichever of the two you wish'?" He عليه السلام said: "He has indeed treated him fairly."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a case in which two purchased garments become indistinguishable between their respective owners. The Imam عليه السلام rules that both garments should be sold and the proceeds divided according to each person’s original financial share, while also affirming the fairness of allowing the higher contributor to choose first.
en.seo_question: How should the price be divided when two buyers' garments are mixed up and cannot be identified?

key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: dirhams; the monetary amount entrusted for purchase
key_terms.ثَوْبٍ: a garment purchased on behalf of a buyer
key_terms.يُبَاعُ: is to be sold; the legal remedy when ownership cannot be distinguished
key_terms.الثَّمَنِ: the sale price or proceeds to be apportioned
key_terms.أَخْمَاسِ: fifths; the proportional basis for dividing the proceeds
key_terms.أَنْصَفَهُ: he treated him fairly; a judgment affirming equitable conduct
